_comment: Layout of the submitted supplementary tables (lead decision, 2026-11-10; Haoran: 'do what you recommended and go further toward the guideline').
npj Digital Medicine: supplementary tables are either reproduced in the single merged Supplementary Information PDF or, when too large,
supplied as Excel files labelled 'Supplementary Data N' whose title and legend appear in the PDF. The 47 Supplementary Tables keep their
S-numbers (captions, notes and manuscript citations unchanged); every table's full workbook content is shipped in one of six themed
Excel files (data_files), and the tables listed under pdf_tables are additionally reproduced as real tables in the PDF (display sheets only).
Sheet names in the Supplementary Data files are prefixed with the table number (S8_...). pdf_tables[...].columns = subset of header
names shown (None = all); decimals = float printing (default 3); landscape = page orientation (default: landscape when >= 9 columns);
stop_at_blank = stop at the first empty row (notes written below a table in the same sheet are not rendered).
